finding.failure: Blanket terminal-402 classification prevented the existing native retry processor from retrying a documented temporary reservation conflict.
finding.secondaryFailure: Preserved provider wording mentioning credit balance still hit the existing terminal billing heuristic after status normalization.
finding.reviewRegression: A broad billing-hint exception initially also bypassed permission/auth/consent messages in a cause chain; controlled RED caught it and the final split preserves authority errors unconditionally.

implementation.transport: Gate on configured provider, exact OpenRouter host, POST chat-completion URL, status 402 and exact structured limit_source. Preserve body text and Retry-After while exposing standard 429. Error-body read is signal-abortable; successful streams are returned without inspection. No retry/resubmit is performed by the normalizer.
implementation.classifier: Reuse the exact normalized-provider predicate only to disambiguate billing wording. Auth/permission/consent/invalid request, explicit terminal HTTP statuses, Abort and execution budget stop retain precedence over all temporary metadata.
implementation.retryOwner: Existing public native StreamErrorRetryProcessor; configured retry/fallback budgets and 30000 ms Retry-After cap unchanged.
implementation.accounting: Known refusals remain failed and not possibly billed; successful retry has its own usage row. No billing reset or bypass was added.

controlledRed.observed: Exact source remained HTTP 402 instead of 429; actual SDK made 1 request instead of the expected 2.
Normalized temporary error with credit-balance wording still made 1 request instead of 2.
Broad cause-chain bypass wrongly made all five authority errors transient; final narrow billing-only exception corrects them.

transport: Exact transient limit_source with normal, missing or future reason becomes 429; unchanged body, Retry-After and request limits.
Key cap, credits/weight_exceeds_budget, unknown or reason-only metadata remain one-attempt 402.
OpenAI source, non-OpenRouter host, embeddings and opaque refusals retain their semantics.
Successful SSE has no new text/clone read; Stop interrupts a held 402 body read.

twoRequestsSamePrimary: temporary source with misleading credit-balance wording
temporary source wrapped with billing wording
assertions: Temporary retries wait at least 900 ms for Retry-After: 1.
Each HTTP attempt has one ledger row; refusal is not possibly billed, successful retry has its exact synthetic cost.
Stop finishes before the one-second backoff and starts no second request.

rootAcceptance: Pending independent root Gate9 compiled/full-suite acceptance. Focused proof is not external provider or production acceptance.
